metaTitle: Custom High Visibility Caps | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom high visibility caps for safety and branding. Perfect Imprints offers bulk pricing and fast turnaround.
introHtml: High visibility caps keep your team seen and safe on job sites, parking lots, or outdoor events. Unlike standard caps, these feature reflective strips and bright neon colors that meet safety requirements. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that stands out day or night. Ideal for construction crews, traffic control, or warehouse staff who need both protection and brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom high visibility caps with reflective strips and neon fabric for safety and branding
